Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of lumbar and thoracic back strain. The
reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury described. Over the course of 18 visits, care followed a
typical progression, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, with visit frequency
tapering steadily as symptoms improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the
lumbar and throacic paraspinal musculature. No prior injury or treatment involving this body area is known to this provider.
Billed services correspond to the care documented in the clinical record, with no duplicated or repeated charges identified. At
discharge, the patient demonstrated substantial functional recovery with minimal residual limitation and was released to full
activity with instructions to return as needed.
